calendar.title: Plain calendar arithmetic, no statutory roll

deemed_delivery.title: Registered letter from an office or a tax office, not collected after notice (awizo)
deemed_delivery.from: the day the first notice was left
deemed_delivery.note: Counts as delivered on the last day of the 14-day collection period. The response window starts from that day.

deemed_delivery.title: Registered letter from a court, not collected after two notices
deemed_delivery.from: the day the first notice was left
deemed_delivery.law: KPC art. 139 § 1; court delivery regulation (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 19) § 6 to § 8; Supreme Court IV CKN 1026/00
deemed_delivery.note: Each notice gives 7 days counted from the day after it; the letter counts as delivered on the last day of the second period, usually 15 days after the first notice (7 days after the second notice when its date is known). A first letter to a private defendant may be served by a bailiff (KPC art. 139¹ § 1); if the claimant proves the address, the original date stands (art. 139¹ § 3). An electronic payment order counts as served at the PESEL-register address (KPC art. 505³⁴).

deemed_delivery.title: Message from a public body in the e-Doręczenia box, not opened
deemed_delivery.from: the day the message reached the delivery box
deemed_delivery.law: ustawa o doręczeniach elektronicznych art. 41 ust. 1 pkt 3, art. 42 ust. 2
deemed_delivery.note: Counts as delivered on the day after the 14 days that start when it reached the box. Opened earlier means delivered on the day of opening.
